item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: Fans Are Convinced That The Latest Trailer Has Edited Out Some Major Spoilers
item.description: The fourth and final Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer was released yesterday, and many fans are convinced that Marvel Studios has edited out some significant characters and vehicles.

item.title: SHE-HULK Star Tatiana Maslany (Jokingly?) Says She Turned Down A Role In AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law star Tatiana Maslany has responded to reports she won't appear in Avengers: Doomsday, but is she telling the truth or just feeding the trolls?

item.title: SPIDER-MAN/SUPERMAN Crossover Brings Geoff Johns Back To Marvel; Will Feature Lex Luthor/Green Goblin Team-up
item.description: We have a first look at Spider-Man/Superman #1, the all-new Marvel/DC crossover one-shot featuring stories by Brad Meltzer, Pepe Larraz, Brian Michael Bendis, Geoff Johns, Jason Aaron, and more.

item.title: James Gunn Confirms MISTER MIRACLE Animated Series Is Officially Set In The DCU
item.description: James Gunn has just confirmed that Mister Miracle, the upcoming animated series based on Tom King and Mitch Gerads’ seminal book, is officially DCU canon.

item.title: Warner Bros. Film Bosses Believe JOKER: FOLIE À DEUX Failed Because It Was Too "Revisionist" For Moviegoers
item.description: Warner Bros. Pictures bosses Pamela Abdy and Michael De Luca have revealed why they stand by Joker: Folie à Deux, arguing that it was "too revisionist" for mainstream moviegoers.

item.title: RUMOR: New Details On Doctor Doom's AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Allies; MIDNIGHT SONS Roster Reportedly Revealed
item.description: The latest Avengers: Doomsday rumour claims to shed more light on Doctor Doom's mysterious masked allies. We also have a minor update on the likely Midnight Sons roster.

item.title: GOD OF WAR Video Game Actor Cast As Kratos In Prime Video's Upcoming Live-Action TV Series
item.description: Prime Video's God of War TV series has finally found its Kratos, with Sons of Anarchy star Ryan Hurst set to bring the iconic PlayStation character to life in live-action.

item.title: SILVER & BLACK: Everything You Need To Know About Sony's Unmade Black Cat And Silver Sable Team-up
item.description: With Black Cat back in the conversation, we're revisiting Silver & Black's leaked plot, and you might be shocked by how much this Silver Sable team-up has in common with Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
